content.title: How to Watch the Giants | San Francisco Giants
content.text: Giants fans can continue to watch games on NBC Sports Bay Area via a TV provider and in-market streaming options, while continuing to listen on KNBR and Radio Lazer. NEW IN-MARKET STREAMING OPTIONSIf you live in San Francisco Giants team territory and have a provider that includes NBC Sports Bay Area, you can stream the Giants on the NBC Sports app. Providers include YouTube TV, Hulu, Xfinity, FuboTV and DirectTV Stream.Watch in-market Giants games on Peacock. Add NBC Sports Bay Area to your Peacock subscription. Stream LIVE games, pre and postgame shows, exclusive interviews and more. In partnership with NBC Sports Bay Area, stream Giants games, along with pre and postgame shows, in the Giants home television territory without blackouts on GIANTS.TV. If you’re outside of the San Francisco Giants team territory you can stream Giants games on MLB.TV.TICKET MEMBER OFFERGiants Full and Half Season Ticket Members receive a complimentary subscription to MLB.TV® for the 2026 season.*Blackout and other restrictions apply. Blackout restrictions subject to change. High speed internet access is required. For more information, click here. For a full list of supported devices, visit mlb.tv/devices.NATIONAL BROADCASTSFans will also have the opportunity to tune into nationally broadcasted games on FOX, Roku, ESPN and Apple TV. OUT-OF-MARKETIf you’re outside of the San Francisco Giants team territory you can stream Giants games on MLB.TV.RADIOListen to Giants action on KNBR and Radio Lazer English-language radio broadcasts: KNBR 680 AM & 104.5 FM Spanish-language radio broadcasts: KSFN 1510 AM in San Francisco & KXZM 93.7 FM Giants Radio Network Stream in-market and out-of-market radio broadcasts on the MLB.com app
